supply.structurally_additive_not_standalone_hig: Two starts per paired day can only be an additive sleeve; it is below the project-wide three actual starts/day standalone high-turnover line.

P1_2022H2_2023.interpretation: The initial evidence block fails before any confirmation logic. Gross edge is only $2.7519 and is already negative under observed bid/ask cost; both calendar splits, symbols and predictor signs fail the required breadth.

P2_2024.interpretation: Combined dollars are barely positive after stress, but PF, efficiency, US100 and DOWN continuation show no broad confirmation.

P3_2025.interpretation: This is a real, broad and cost-resilient 2025 regime. It cannot select the rule retroactively because the literature direction was fixed, and it cannot rescue negative initial, 2026 and latest blocks.

P4_2026_JAN_MAY.interpretation: The mechanism turns negative even before observed cost and loses on both symbols after stress.

P5_LATEST_2026_JUN_JUL.interpretation: The latest loss fails both nominal and predeclared practical tolerance. Its symbol and predictor-side orientation also reverses relative to earlier blocks.

P2_P4_CONFIRMATION.interpretation: Pooled confirmation looks positive only because strong 2025 offsets 2024 breadth failure and fully negative P4.

P1_P4_PRELATEST.interpretation: Day-level profit is not dominated by a handful of outliers, but economic value is regime- and symbol-concentrated. Only 11.30% of gross net survives doubled cost, with PF near one and DD materially beyond both risk lines.

P1_P5_FULL.interpretation: The full path remains nominally positive only in dollars. PF 1.0136, 27.02% DD, negative US100 and unstable sign orientation make it economically unusable.

temporal_shape.interpretation: The failure is not a single-tail-event artifact. The broad 2025 block is surrounded by negative initial, 2026 and latest economics; monthly breadth is 22/48 positive.

gate_result.marginal_judgment: Not applicable as a rescue. DD exceeds the practical line by 5.8211 percentage points, latest loss is about 16.34 times the allowed absolute loss, and multiple independent economic breadth/efficiency gates fail.

causal_interpretation.literature_transfer: A real 2025 cash-close momentum regime exists in this FPMarkets proxy, but the exact unconditional two-index rule does not transfer reliably across the complete project horizon.
causal_interpretation.cost_role: Cost matters materially: observed execution turns weak P1 gross profit negative and doubled cost consumes 88.70% of pooled P1-P4 gross net. Cost is not the sole cause because P1A and P4 are already gross-negative and temporal/symbol orientation reverses.
causal_interpretation.regime_role: P3 contributes +$28.3671 stressed while the full P1-P5 path retains only +$4.8769; other blocks remove $23.4902. This is regime concentration, not broad stationary alpha.
causal_interpretation.direction_role: UP and DOWN subgroup signs change across blocks. A long-only, short-only or regime router would be a new post-outcome rescue and is forbidden by the declaration.
causal_interpretation.portfolio_role: Because the standalone bundle fails stressed economics, shared-account admission or diversification cannot be invoked as a rescue. No Optimization integration counterfactual is authorized.
